method: Pinned logic/client CSV and SC1 geometry imports; no original client execution or native projectile-code result.
observations: Rocket is Rare, costs six elixir, and binds RocketSpell with damage 700, speed 350, radius 2000, CrownTowerDamagePercent -60, Pushback 1800, Gravity 50 and enemy air/ground targeting.

projectile_rocket has 60 frames at 60 FPS. Resolved original shapes depict a pitch cycle with a vertical long axis; they are not 60 compass headings. The native origin lies near the body/exhaust attachment.
Rocket_Emitter retains smoke, sparks, glow and a delayed smoke component at 800 ms. Rocket_explosion retains eight particle layers and a 1.5-second shake duration.
Cast and impact sound bindings, portrait, source rows and SHA-256 hashes are retained in the import manifests.
reconstructionChoices: Normalize damage to round(700 * 689 / 325) = 1484 using the existing Fireball scale. Retain the archived 40% Crown Tower damage fraction; existing direct spells keep their historical browser 30% fallback.

Convert source speed to 350/60 tiles per second, radius to two tiles, and knockback to 1.8 tiles. Use fixed planar targeting, the existing six-tile sine arc and King launch origins; source gravity 50 remains recorded without claiming native ballistic parity.

Map camera-relative pitch around native side-profile frame 50, then roll the billboard along its screen-space tangent. The original direction-to-frame formula is unverified. The imported native shadow is retained but not rendered until its projection can be matched confidently.

Repeat the 800-ms trail envelope along the reconstructed flight. Each particle is anchored to the projectile position at its authored birth delay, clipped at impact. Simulation-age cursors rebuild live smoke after a late snapshot or replay seek. Existing particle physics, layering, pause and the shared 1280-particle cap apply.
Use existing heavy-unit knockback immunity and hidden-Tesla targeting rules. Optional projectile tower-damage metadata preserves old recorded matches without changing their replay version.
unknowns: Original gravity integration, launch height and native 360-frame pitch selection.
Whether native trail emitter restart, delayed attachment and shadow projection exactly match this browser reconstruction.
